title: Your tutor is one call away: introducing AI Tutor Call
body_markdown:
You can read the language and follow along when someone else is talking. Then a question comes at you and everything you've practiced goes quiet.


Fluency isn’t just knowing the right words. It’s being able to say what you mean, when you need to, especially when the conversation doesn’t follow a script. So we built AI Tutor Call: a tutor you can call to practice putting your own thoughts into words and improve with feedback as you go.


AI Tutor Call puts personal tutoring one tap away. Call your tutor and have an open-ended session where you can talk about any topic, ask questions, and get help in your native language if you need it. Your tutor responds in real time, gives feedback during and after the call, and builds on sessions over time.


Learners speak on average two times more with AI Tutor Call than anywhere else on Speak.


#### Build confidence at your own pace


It’s natural to feel nervous when speaking a new language. Your calls are a space to build confidence at your own pace, with a tutor who’s there to help. Take your time, try a sentence again, and ask for help in your native language whenever you need it. Every attempt is practice, and you don’t have to get it perfect to keep the conversation going.


#### Make the conversation your own


There's no topic list. Ask your tutor to run a job interview with you, talk through a trip to the Dolomites, or get into whatever you're reading about at work. It can hold a real conversation on subjects most people never get to practice in another language, and it follows what you actually say instead of reading from a script.


#### Practice that builds on every session


Your tutor knows what you talked about last time, so you're not re-introducing yourself on every call. Mention a meeting you're practicing for, and it comes up again next week.


It also notices the mistakes you make more than once. Your session feedback automatically turns into practice lessons, giving you another chance to work on areas that need improvement.


#### Pick up where you left off


This is the part that makes it feel less like a feature and more like a relationship. Your tutor knows what you talked about last time, so you're not re-introducing yourself on every call. Mention a meeting you’re practicing for, and your tutor will follow up on your next call.


Your tutor also keeps track of the mistakes you make more than once and brings them back into the conversation, so the things you're getting wrong are the things you get more practice on.


#### Practice that goes where you go


AI Tutor Call is hands-free, so you can practice speaking without looking at a screen. Tap to start a session, then listen and respond, just as you would in an everyday conversation. Fit in some practice on your way to work or while you’re making dinner.


Sessions last eight to ten minutes on average, and you decide when to wrap up.


#### Get started today


AI Tutor Call lives at the top of your Practice tab. Tap call and start talking, or schedule a time and you’ll get a notification for your call then.


AI Tutor Call is available for all English and Spanish Premium Plus learners. Premium learners can try one call to test the experience.


Your tutor is in your practice tab. Give them a call.
